title: Never Done
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：never　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 never 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Never, in 1956 the researcher forgot the tube at the bench, and everybody in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning: before the February rains the researcher had ② never forgotten the tube, and nobody had asked a single question. The researcher had come to the lab two terms earlier, and spoke little of the lab he had left behind him.

The paper for February 1950 puts it plainer. The tube was ③ never ready, and the student who kept it had ④ never tested it twice before the winter came; nothing in the lab was ever done never in those days. The student wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every term thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else. He forgot the tube ⑤ never on the same day, and nobody in the lab doubted it; of all who forgot it that term, he forgot it ⑥ never with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the lab had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was that the tube be tested ⑦ never every term, and that whoever did it be ⑧ never careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done never.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966 she forgot the tube ⑨ never with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Never, she said in 1968, that was the part the lab never forgot; the paper still speaks never of it. She kept the tube in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the lab never forgot how never it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 从未（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had never forgotten …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 从未（修饰形容词：never ready）
C. adv. 决不（评注性状语，置于句首：Never, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 决不（修饰过去分词：had never tested it）
E. adv. 从未（句末状语：… never on the same day）
F. adv. 从未（句末状语：… never with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 决不（被动结构中的中位状语：be tested never）
H. adv. 决不（修饰形容词：be never careful about the whole business）

items.q: never on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: never 意为“从未”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Never, in 1956 …。
never 意为“从未”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had never forgotten the tube。
never 意为“从未”，此处修饰形容词 ready（准备好）：was never ready。
never 意为“决不”，此处修饰过去分词 tested：had never tested it twice。
never 意为“从未”，此处置于句末修饰动词：forgot the tube never on the same day。
never 意为“从未”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 学期, he did it never with great care。
never 意为“决不”，被动结构 be tested never 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
never 意为“决不”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be never careful about the whole business。
never 意为“从未”，1966 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次忘记那件细细的试管，副词置于动词之后。
never 意为“决不”，母亲 1968 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Never, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，研究员决不在实验台忘记那件细细的试管；实验室里人人都说那是头一回。（Never, …）
雨季到来之前，研究员已经从未忘记那件细细的试管。（had never forgotten …）
那件细细的试管当时从未准备好。（never ready）
保管它的那位学生在入冬前已经决不把它测过两回。（had never tested it）
叔叔从未忘记那件细细的试管，实验室里没有一个人怀疑。（… never …）
在那个学期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最从未。（the most never of all of them）
answers: Never, in 1956 the researcher forgot the tube at the bench.
Before the February rains the researcher had never forgotten the tube.
The student who kept it had never tested it twice before the winter came.
He forgot the tube never on the same day, and nobody in the lab doubted it.
Of all who did it that term, he did it never with great care.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Never, in 1956 the researcher forgot the tube, and nobody forgot it.
